gravityModel.model_role: explanatory structural allocation and under-representation analysis
gravityModel.formula: students_observed ~ ln_student_pool + ln_distance + ln_outbound + ln_outbound_missing + tertiary_share + tertiary_share_missing + unga_alignment + unga_alignment_missing + region fixed effects + year fixed effects
gravityModel.estimator: Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood with origin-clustered sandwich covariance
gravityModel.dependent_variable_semantics: enrolled stock of internationally mobile students in Russia

core.validation_estimator: regularized PoissonRegressor approximation; final inference uses statsmodels PPML

mobility.validation_estimator: regularized PoissonRegressor approximation; final inference uses statsmodels PPML

theory_ex_ante.validation_estimator: regularized PoissonRegressor approximation; final inference uses statsmodels PPML

persistence_benchmark.name: recent_observed_share_2019_2021
persistence_benchmark.purpose: short-horizon predictive benchmark; not used to construct structural potential

coefficients.transform: ln(1 + UNESCO UIS outbound mobility ratio)
UNESCO/World Bank tertiary gross enrolment percent / 100
recency- and controversy-weighted UNGA vote agreement with Russia, 5-year trailing window

diagnostics.year_effects: included in estimation; omitted from future structural-share prediction and replaced by an explicit aggregate capacity path
diagnostics.future_covariate_policy: UN WPP student pool varies through 2050; distance is invariant; outbound mobility, tertiary enrolment and UNGA alignment are frozen at their latest observed values
diagnostics.missingness_policy: country-specific forward fill; outbound mobility, tertiary enrolment and governance/access indicators are lagged one year; remaining missing values receive the training median and a missingness indicator
diagnostics.time_holdout_interpretation: predictions are calibrated to each holdout year's observed total so metrics evaluate origin allocation, not an unknowable destination-year intercept
diagnostics.benchmark_policy: recent observed shares are reported as a predictive benchmark but excluded from structural-potential construction to prevent outcome circularity
diagnostics.excluded_years: years with fewer than 150 Russia-origin rows or no positive observations are excluded from estimation

forecast_uncertainty.method: multivariate-normal coefficient simulation propagated through constrained destination shares and the fixed annual Russia total
forecast_uncertainty.gap_probability_semantics: share of coefficient draws in which structural capacity exceeds demographic-continuity potential
forecast_uncertainty.rank_uncertainty_semantics: conditional rank among non-excluded countries with a positive simulated gap

vacancyCompetency.semantics: record-level PII-free thematic sample; relative program-demand index, not national vacancy count

model.opportunity_policy: structural gap score is multiplied by the coefficient-draw probability that the gap is positive
model.uncertainty_policy: published evidence bounds combine gap parameter quantiles, friendliness missingness bounds, labor-query bootstrap intervals and scenario-weight sensitivity
model.effect_policy: no numerical recruitment effect is fabricated; incremental effects require a prospective campaign evaluation
model.interpretation: The median across transparent management scenarios is the headline score; evidence bounds and rank spread expose data, parameter and weight sensitivity.
model.non_claim: The index is not a predicted student count, unique-vacancy count or causal impact estimate.
model.tier_a_policy: moderate/high friendliness evidence and >=100 classified vacancies required

coverage.missingPolicy: Rows without verified open numeric evidence are excluded from denominators.

countryProgramPriority.opportunity_policy: structural gap score is multiplied by the coefficient-draw probability that the gap is positive
countryProgramPriority.uncertainty_policy: published evidence bounds combine gap parameter quantiles, friendliness missingness bounds, labor-query bootstrap intervals and scenario-weight sensitivity
countryProgramPriority.effect_policy: no numerical recruitment effect is fabricated; incremental effects require a prospective campaign evaluation
countryProgramPriority.interpretation: The median across transparent management scenarios is the headline score; evidence bounds and rank spread expose data, parameter and weight sensitivity.
countryProgramPriority.non_claim: The index is not a predicted student count, unique-vacancy count or causal impact estimate.
countryProgramPriority.tier_a_policy: moderate/high friendliness evidence and >=100 classified vacancies required
